dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We have branches all around Teyvat! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You can meet fellow adventurers in the guild, participate in expeditions to every corner of the land, and get paid for completing commissions...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This truly is heaven for all adventurers! You sure you're not interested, kid? Hahaha...
